decisions: Kept the implementation sequential because P2, P3, and P4 share package, runtime, Control Plane, and verification contracts.
Filesystem remains the local default; HARNESS_DATABASE_URL selects PostgreSQL runtime coordination and read models.
Loopback Control Plane access remains tokenless for local development; non-loopback binding requires HARNESS_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN.
GitNexus CLI 1.6.9 is pinned and graph freshness/provider health are required gates.
remaining: A real PostgreSQL deployment still needs db:migrate and db:check against its configured database URL.
TLS termination, identity-to-actor mapping, RBAC, CSRF protection for cookie deployments, secret rotation, and durable audit shipping remain deployment responsibilities.
Live Codex App Server execution remains deferred to a later phase.
risks: The local environment uses Node 24; canonical CI runtime remains Node 22 with pnpm 10.
The local GitNexus provider uses exact-scan semantic fallback because VECTOR index is unavailable on Windows.
